parsed.text: This packet contains paired red/blue location distributions over 4×4 local grids for nodes n0–n3 in panels p0 and p1. Copied prior records are not new estimates; conditional command records are conditional estimates, not executed events. Current estimates (panel p0 and p1): at n0 blue peaks at cell [0,1] and red at [0,3]; n1 and n2 show uniform distributions (all 16 cells tied); n3 in both panels is uniform in the current view. Conditional candidate records differ mainly at n3: some command branches (k0) allocate blue mass to the top-right 2×2 block and red mass to the top-left 2×2 block; other branches (k2) concentrate blue at [1,2] and red at [0,1]; k1 generally matches the current uniform or current n0/n1/n2 patterns. Numerical peak locations and which branches differ are provided in the proposition list.
